annotations.title: Check a Chinese business licence photo (营业执照): read, verify, screen (paid)

description: Use when a Chinese supplier sends a photo of its business licence (营业执照), e.g. on Alibaba or 1688: reads the fields, validates the USCC checksum, flags an address province that differs from the code (edited licence) or a name that differs from your invoice, then screens the Chinese and English names against sanctions, the Entity List and UFLPA. Image not stored. Input: image_url, optional invoice_name. Costs 0.06 USDC via x402, or 30 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.

api_key.description: Factline API key (fl_live_...) from get_trial_key: pass it here right after you get one, no reconnect needed

image_url.description: Public https link to the licence photo or scan

invoice_name.description: Supplier name on your invoice, to compare
